preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains an integer n representing the text length, where 1 <= n <= 2*10^6.
The second line contains exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in lines[1].strip())
preconditions.description: The text consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(1 for i in range(len(subpalindromes)) for j in range(i+1, len(subpalindromes)) if cross(subpalindromes[i], subpalindromes[j])) % 51123987)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct pairs of subpalindromes that cross each other, modulo 51123987. A pair (A, B) crosses if their intervals [start_A, end_A] and [start_B, end_B] share at least one position (i.e., max(start_A, start_B) <= min(end_A, end_B)). The set of subpalindromes includes every occurrence of every palindrome in the text, identified by their 1-based start and end positions. Pairs are unordered and distinct if the set of two subpalindromes differs.
